title: Keyboard collision for many keyboard shortcuts
assessment: Official Chrome, Firefox, and Edge shortcut references confirm that Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+H and Ctrl+Shift+O are browser-owned. Baseline Varve binds those chords to Home and Outline Mode; the editor shortcut listener prevents their default browser behavior. The fix uses Ctrl/Cmd+Alt+Shift+F/O, rejects reserved browser bindings from capture/import, and leaves desktop keymaps platform-reserved only. Live-browser regression and affected validation are pending.

title: Importing SVG with lots of fonts  kills performance
assessment: The attached 1,086,776-byte SVG has 523 text elements, 966 font-family declarations, and 11 unique family values (Arial, Candara, Carlito, Georgia, Gotham, Manufaktur, Nemesia, OpenSymbol, Oswald, monospace, sans-serif). Its text styles are declared inline. Baseline convertText read font properties only from direct attributes, so styled nodes fell back to sans-serif/16px/400/left. The bounded fix now reads inline family, unit-aware size, weight keywords, and text-anchor. Focused unit and original-fixture parser checks pass; browser rendering/visual verification is queued.
engineeringEvidence: Reproduced with the cached original Penpot SVG and a minimal unit regression; parser now retains inline font family, size, weight, and alignment. E2E rendered-text screenshot and inspector confirmation remain pending.
